# Staff Platform Engineer

**Company:** Lumen Payments
**Location:** Remote (US)

## About the role

We are looking for a Staff Platform Engineer to own our internal developer platform. You will
shape how 300 engineers build, ship and run services on Kubernetes in AWS.

## What you will do

- Lead the design and evolution of our Kubernetes-based platform on AWS (EKS)
- Define infrastructure as code standards using Terraform and drive adoption across teams
- Build golden paths and self-service tooling that cut time to first deploy
- Improve CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Argo CD) for speed and safety
- Partner with security on compliance controls (PCI DSS, SOC 2)
- Mentor senior engineers and set technical direction

## What you bring

- 8+ years of software or infrastructure engineering experience
- Deep hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production
- Strong experience with Terraform (required)
- Experience with AWS at scale
- Proficiency in Go or Python
- Experience with observability tooling such as Prometheus and Grafana

## Nice to have

- Experience with Backstage or similar developer portals
- Background in fintech or other regulated industries
- Argo CD or Flux

Salary range: $210,000 - $250,000. This is a full-time role.
